subject: general
question: Kendriya Hindi Sansthan is an autonoumous educational institution established in 1960 by the Department of Higher Education of the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Where is its headquarters located?
solution:
The correct answer is__ __**__Agra__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kendriya Hindi Sansthan/ Central Institute of Hindi** is an institute that promotes the Hindi language. 
 
• This institute is run by the Ministry of Human Resource Development.
 
• It was established by the** Department of Higher Education in 1960.**
 
• Its headquarter is in **Agra.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This institute has **eight regional centers** - Delhi, Hyderabad, Mysore, Shillong, Dimapur, Guwahati, Ahmedabad, and Bhubaneswar. 
 
• The first chairman of this institute was **Moturi Satyanarayana.**
 
• This institute conducts various projects for teaching, training, and research & propagation of Hindi.
